name.value: Ten Mile Bay North Group Site

description.value: A group site within the new Ten Mile Bay Campground on the west shore of Harrison Lake, reached via roughly 15 km of forest service road; the lakeside setting offers beach access and a relaxed atmosphere, but it is dry camping (no potable water), outhouses only, and the FSR approach will be washboard for a loaded bike.

address.value: Ten Mile Bay, Fraser Valley, BC V0M 1A0, Canada

raw_osm.name: Ten Mile Bay North Group Site

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website describes Ten Mile Bay Campground broadly as a dry-camping site with 'very limited amenities' and explicitly lists electricity/power and (truncated) potable water as 'Not Available,' supporting false values for power-dependent amenities. OSM confirms group_only=yes, which is consistent with the site being listed under 'All Group Sites' in the navigation rather than having individual campsites. The operator's website has a dedicated reservations system listing this group site as bookable, confirming reservations are accepted. Notices dated May 2026 confirm the operator's campgrounds are open for the current season.
concerns: Site is group_only=yes per OSM tags, restricting access to groups rather than individual cycle tourists.

The linked URL resolves to the main Ten Mile Bay Campground page, not a dedicated subpage for the North Group Site; site-specific details such as group capacity and layout could not be confirmed from the fetched content.
No physical address or phone number is present in OSM or on the website for this specific group site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a group-only campsite (OSM group_only=yes), which means individual touring cyclists cannot book it; it is only accessible to organized groups. Editorial judgment is needed on whether group-only sites belong in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Firewood is available for purchase from the on-site camp host. The campground is described as new, built in spring 2026. Pack-in/pack-out waste policy is in effect.
